Pearl Gomez: Hey all — Pearl here, starting today on Eng Platform! SF office, she/her. Excited to meet y'all :wave: Quick Qs: is my badge already at reception? Also I'm team 'plants + espresso' — desk plant named Cactus Stan and I drink oat capp. Would love a window desk if there's a spare.
welcome-bot: :tada: Pearl Gomez has joined #new-hires. Welcome! Please check onboarding: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding and join #eng-platform.
Asha (People Ops): Hi Pearl! Welcome :sparkles: Badge's been provisioned. Bring an ID to reception and they'll hand it to you. I'll DM you about paperwork.
Jon (IT): Hey Pearl — if your laptop isn't ready ping me. Want a Linux dev kit by default? If yes run this at your desk when you're on wifi:
`/device enrol pearl-gomez --os=linux`
Maya (Eng Platform): Welcome!! Coffee club at 10:30 on Floor 3 — come by. We also do a tiny succ/potluck every Friday. Window desk fans, rally here :seedling:
Sam (Desk-mate): She/her here too. Obsessed with cardamom lattes. If Cactus Stan needs a name tag, we have a labelmaker in the kitchen. :cactus:
Pearl Gomez: Thanks — @Asha I'll swing by reception after standup. @Jon yes please for Linux. @Maya count me in for coffee. Quick (totally scientific) poll — what should I bring tomorrow? React with :one: for donuts, :two: for empanadas, :three: for banana bread.
Nina (People Ops): I'll tally reactions at midday :clipboard: Also FYI we have a welcome cookie in the breakroom for new hires.
Rex (Eng): +1 to window desk. Also taco group at lunch (Taqueria on 4th) if you're into that :taco:
Pearl Gomez: Tacos and coffee and plants — perfect first-day combo. See you all in a bit! :smile:
